claims.title: Why is the map from the tower to the generic fibre finite étale?
claims.hypotheses: At the reference level the tower is identified with an open and closed part of the integral generic fibre. The change of marking is finite étale and the principal-level fibres carry the level action.
claims.statement: The comparison is finite étale. Any two points above one geometric point differ by an element of the subgroup preserving the two markings.
